notes.title: Summer 2024 Update
notes.content:
Upgraded the game to the latest Unity version.
Added Music Player.
Added 3 different environment options for building stages.
Moved Day/Night Cycle button to the lower toolbar
and added rainy and snowy weather options.
Fixed a few bugs.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: MIDI Control with Full Customization
notes.content:
Now it's possible to control DMX consoles in the game with MIDI device.
Anything from a simple MIDI Keyboard to Launchpad grid controller and APC style controllers would work.
It has plenty of options to support any MIDI device. It supports both MIDI keys and gradual input sources like faders and knobs on a MIDI device. Setting your MIDI device will just take a few minutes and the necessary help information is available in the game.

Realityocean Games

notes.title: Fix for Led Panel Voxels
notes.content:
